info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: The Retrieve Direct Debit Mandate Details API allows consumers to access specific information related to trade banking mandates using a unique identifier (param1). This endpoint is particularly valuable for financial institutions and businesses looking to verify or analyze direct debit transactions. By using this API, clients can seamlessly retrieve mandate details to support decision-making processes and enhance customer service. Common use cases include auditing financial records or confirming payment arrangements.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific direct debit mandate using its unique identifier. It provides essential information regarding the mandate's status, participant details, and transaction history, making it a crucial part of trade banking operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the direct debit mandate details for a specified resource. Ensure to provide all necessary information as per the defined schema to successfully fetch the mandate data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the direct debit mandate details.

GetTradeBankingByParam1Request.description: Represents the request body for retrieving direct debit mandate details in Trade Banking operations.
